subject: Request: onboarding form errors, spend slice and line-item adjustment
messages:
From: Julia Perez <julia.perez@cloudworks.io>
To: marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com, monica_patel@redwood-inference.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding form missing spend slab and PO request

Hi Marcus / Monica,

We're finishing our vendor intake for HelixPay and attached is the onboarding form they returned. Their finance team says they need a provisional PO number and confirmation of the spend cap so they can start provisioning billing.

Quick notes from our side (from the intake):
- Vendor listed three line items (setup fee, monthly subscription, integration support) but the totals in their CSV don't match the breakdown on the PDF form.
- CloudWorks requires a provisional PO while legal and procurement finalize the purchase agreement.

Can Redwood issue a provisional PO with a spend cap of $120,000 (initial quarter) and confirm the canonical line-item codes we should expect invoices to map to? If you'd like, we can join a 30-min call with HelixPay to walk through line items.

Thanks,
Julia Perez
Procurement Lead, CloudWorks
[julia.perez@cloudworks.io]

[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form_original.pdf (PDF, 412KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
To: Julia Perez <julia.perez@cloudworks.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding form missing spend slab and PO request

Thanks Julia — looping in Monica (Vendor Ops) and Irene (Procurement) to coordinate. Before issuing anything, we need the vendor to resubmit the breakdowned CSV with unit prices and a short clarifying note on why the totals differ. Two quick asks for HelixPay:

- Put unit qty and unit price for each line (not just a single total row).
- Reconcile the CSV total vs. the PDF line sums (call out any discounts or rounding).

If HelixPay can get that back by EOD tomorrow we can issue a provisional PO number (provisionally capped at $120,000) and a spend-slab instruction for invoicing. If there are material changes to scope we will revise the cap.

Proposed next step: 30-min touch with HelixPay tomorrow 10:00 AM PT to close details. Monica — can you confirm availability and whether we should route the PO through the restricted-spend flow?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Vendor Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.txt]

From: Amanda Cho <amanda@helixpay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>, Julia Perez <julia.perez@cloudworks.io>
Cc: HelixPay Billing <vendor-admin@helixpay.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding form missing spend slab and PO request

Thanks Marcus — attached is the corrected CSV and a short note explaining the mismatch. The difference came from a bundled discount applied at the invoice-level that wasn't broken out in the original export. We've split the discount across the three lines and added unit pricing.

Attachments included:
- vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (updated)
- provisional_po_CLW-78923.csv (line-level breakdown)
- lineitems_correction_notes.txt (explain discount allocation)

We can join the 10:00 AM PT call tomorrow — Amanda and I will be on. Let us know the calendar invite.

Amanda Cho
Billing Operations, HelixPay
vendor-admin@helixpay.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
To: Amanda Cho <amanda@helixpay.com>, Julia Perez <julia.perez@cloudworks.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Provisional PO issued and line-item normalization guidance (CLW-78923)

Hi Amanda / Julia — thanks for the updated files and for joining the call. Per our conversation we have:

1) Issued provisional PO: PO-CLW-78923-PROV (effective immediately). This is a provisional authorization to begin provisioning and invoice submission only. It is capped at $120,000 for the initial 90-day period.

2) Line-item normalization: Procurement (Irene) confirmed the canonical codes below that HelixPay should map invoices to. Any invoice line that does not map to one of these codes will be routed for manual review and may delay payment.
   - L1001: Implementation / setup (one-time)
   - S2002: Subscription (monthly recurring)
   - S3003: Integration support (hourly)

3) Corrected totals: We accepted the discount allocation and verified the CSV matches the PDF after the split. Please use the revised CSV for invoice submission (attached).

4) Next actions for HelixPay:
- Submit the first invoice referencing PO-CLW-78923-PROV and attach the mapped CSV.
- If you expect billing to exceed the $120,000 cap within the 90-day window, notify procurement (irene_choi@redwood-inference.com) with a projection and supporting justification so we can expedite an increase.

Cc'ing Irene for procurement record and Monica for vendor onboarding closure.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Vendor Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com

[Attachment: provisional_po_CLW-78923.csv]
